426:         self.batch_size = batch_size
427:         self.verbose = verbose
428:         self.optimizer = optimizer
429:         self.weight_regularizer = weight_regularizer
430:         self.shapelet_length = shapelet_length
431:         self.total_lengths = total_lengths
432:         self.max_size = max_size
433:         self.scale = scale
434:         self.random_state = random_state
435: 
436:     @property
437:     def _n_shapelet_sizes(self):
438:         return len(self.n_shapelets_per_size_)
439: 
440:     @property
441:     def shapelets_(self):
442:         check_is_fitted(self, '_X_fit_dims')
443: 
444:         total_nb_shapelets = sum(self.n_shapelets_per_size_.values())
445:         shapelets = numpy.empty((total_nb_shapelets,), dtype=object)
446:         nb_shapelets_found = 0
447:         for i in range(self._n_shapelet_sizes):
448:             layer = self.model_.get_layer("shapelets_%d" % i)
449:             for weight in layer.get_weights()[0]:
450:                 shapelets[nb_shapelets_found] = weight
451:                 nb_shapelets_found += 1
452:         return shapelets
453: 
454:     @property
455:     def shapelets_as_time_series_(self):
456:         """Set of time-series shapelets formatted as a ``tslearn`` time series
457:         dataset.
458: 
459:         Examples
460:         --------
461:         >>> from tslearn.generators import random_walk_blobs
462:         >>> X, y = random_walk_blobs(n_ts_per_blob=10, sz=256, d=1, n_blobs=3)
463:         >>> model = LearningShapelets(n_shapelets_per_size={3: 2, 4: 1},
464:         ...                       max_iter=1)
465:         >>> _ = model.fit(X, y)
466:         >>> model.shapelets_as_time_series_.shape
467:         (3, 4, 1)
468:         """
469:         check_is_fitted(self, '_X_fit_dims')
470:         n_shapelets_per_size = self.n_shapelets_per_size_
471: 
472:         total_n_shp = sum(n_shapelets_per_size.values())
473:         shp_sz = max(n_shapelets_per_size.keys())
474:         non_formatted_shapelets = self.shapelets_
475:         d = non_formatted_shapelets[0].shape[1]
476:         shapelets = numpy.zeros((total_n_shp, shp_sz, d)) + numpy.nan
477:         for i in range(total_n_shp):
478:             sz = non_formatted_shapelets[i].shape[0]
479:             shapelets[i, :sz, :] = non_formatted_shapelets[i]
480:         return shapelets
481: 
482:     def fit(self, X, y):
483:         """Learn time-series shapelets.
484: 
485:         Parameters
486:         ----------
487:         X : array-like of shape=(n_ts, sz, d)
488:             Time series dataset.
489:         y : array-like of shape=(n_ts, )
490:             Time series labels.
491:         """
492:         if not self.scale:
493:             warnings.warn("The default value for 'scale' is set to False "
494:                           "in version 0.4 to ensure backward compatibility, "
495:                           "but is likely to change in a future version.",
496:                           FutureWarning)
497: 
498:         X, y = check_X_y(X, y, allow_nd=True, force_all_finite=False)
499:         X = self._preprocess_series(X)
500:         X = check_dims(X)
501:         self._check_series_length(X)
502: 
503:         y_ = self._preprocess_labels(y)
504:         n_labels = len(self.classes_)
505: 
506:         if self.random_state is not None:
507:             set_random_seed(seed=self.random_state)
508: 
509:         n_ts, sz, d = self._X_fit_dims = X.shape
510: 
511:         self.model_ = None
512:         self.transformer_model_ = None
513:         self.locator_model_ = None
514: 
515:         if self.n_shapelets_per_size is None:
516:             self.n_shapelets_per_size_ = grabocka_params_to_shapelet_size_dict(
517:                 n_ts,
518:                 self._min_sz_fit,
519:                 n_labels,
520:                 self.shapelet_length,
521:                 self.total_lengths
522:             )
523:         else:
524:             self.n_shapelets_per_size_ = self.n_shapelets_per_size
525: 
526:         self._set_model_layers(X=X, n_classes=n_labels)
527: 
528:         h = self.model_.fit(
529:             X,
530:             y_,
531:             batch_size=self.batch_size,
532:             epochs=self.max_iter,
533:             verbose=self.verbose
534:         )
535:         self.history_ = h.history
536:         self.n_iter_ = len(self.history_.get("loss", []))
537:         self.n_features_in_ = d
538:         return self
539: 
540:     def predict(self, X):
541:         """Predict class for a given set of time series.
542: 
543:         Parameters
544:         ----------
545:         X : array-like of shape=(n_ts, sz, d)
546:             Time series dataset.
547: 
548:         Returns
549:         -------
550:         array of shape=(n_ts, ) or (n_ts, n_classes), depending on the shape
551:         of the label vector provided at training time.
552:             Index of the cluster each sample belongs to or class probability
553:             matrix, depending on what was provided at training time.
554:         """
555:         check_is_fitted(self, '_X_fit_dims')
556:         X = check_array(X, allow_nd=True, force_all_finite=False)
557:         X = self._preprocess_series(X)
558:         X = check_dims(X, X_fit_dims=self._X_fit_dims,
559:                        check_n_features_only=True)
560:         self._check_series_length(X)
561: 
562:         y_ind = self.predict_proba(X).argmax(axis=1)
563:         y_label = numpy.array(
564:             [self.classes_[ind] for ind in y_ind]
565:         )
566:         return y_label
567: 
568:     def predict_proba(self, X):
569:         """Predict class probability for a given set of time series.
570: 
571:         Parameters
572:         ----------
573:         X : array-like of shape=(n_ts, sz, d)
574:             Time series dataset.
575: 
576:         Returns
577:         -------
578:         array of shape=(n_ts, n_classes),
579:             Class probability matrix.
580:         """
581:         check_is_fitted(self, '_X_fit_dims')
